hypothesis: Missing stock SmartApplets cause firmware to enter updater mode
test: Extract stock applets and regenerate recovery seed; boot and type
notes: AlphaWord editor accepts text after setup

hypothesis: LCD display start line is ignored when rendering
test: Write a pixel on RAM line 8, set start line to 8, and check screen line 0
notes: Focused LCD regression demonstrated ignored start line

hypothesis: Timed key script mutates physically held keys and loses modifiers
test: Hold a key, queue it in a timed chord, then advance through release
notes: Regression test lost held Shift on scripted release

hypothesis: Applet validation reports success when its instruction budget expires before the callback returns
test: Inspect return condition and test a zero-step validation
notes: Alpha USB focus handler intentionally stays resident

hypothesis: Timed synthetic key cleanup mutates physically held keys
test: Hold a physical key while a timed tap runs, then release it
notes: Regression reproduced by keyboard review

hypothesis: Timer byte reads ignore the live timer value
test: Compare byte reads with a word read of the timer register
notes: Regression reproduced by memory review

hypothesis: LCD display start line has no effect on rendered output
test: Set a nonzero display start line and inspect snapshot pixels
notes: Regression reproduced by LCD review

hypothesis: GUI pacing loses cycles at frame limits and instruction overshoots
test: Inspect elapsed cap and budget accounting; carry actual execution into next frame
notes: A 20ms frame was limited to 16ms; executed cycles were not subtracted

hypothesis: AlphaWord LCD remains static while idle because firmware cursor timing is not serviced
test: Sample raw LCD after boot over multiple emulated seconds
notes: Raw framebuffer remained identical over 14 emulated seconds; commit 46d382c removed the GUI blink overlay

hypothesis: Calculator misses GUI number keys because the timed press or release is too short for its keyboard scanner
test: Launch Calculator through the firmware menu and send a digit using the actual GUI timed-tap path
notes: All ten GUI-timed digits changed Calculator framebuffer when tested after dismissing help

hypothesis: Czech shifted digits are modified a second time by the NEO held Shift key
test: Send shifted host Text 7 to Calculator and compare LCD with unshifted Text 7
notes: Shifted host digit produced a different Calculator screen; masking held shift during text playback fixes it

hypothesis: Czech unshifted number-row key generates unsupported accented text and its physical digit is ignored
test: Feed a Czech physical Num7 key with text ý to Calculator and compare with text 7
notes: Physical Num7 plus Czech ý produced no input; fallback now enters 7

hypothesis: Czech Shift-digit press and release events before emulation execution break numeric input
test: Feed realistic key/text/release events in separate GUI frames and compare Calculator LCD with an unshifted digit
notes: Simulated key/text/release across frames entered digit correctly

hypothesis: GUI ignores digits delivered as input-method commits
test: Send egui Ime Commit 7 to Calculator and compare with normal text input
notes: Commit event was ignored; regression now passes; actual user input path not verified

hypothesis: Holding NEO Shift before a host digit prevents the firmware from recognizing the queued digit
test: Hold host Shift for several million instructions before digit event and keep it held while firmware runs
notes: Held shift preceding digit caused Calculator regression; delaying Shift until the chord fixes it

hypothesis: Blink overlay mistakes static applet-menu selection marker for an editing cursor
test: Sample applet menu framebuffer and compare GUI blink phases
notes: Menu genuinely contains a two-column XOR cursor over dash; heuristic removed only one column

hypothesis: XOR cursor over the menu dash interrupts one column, so the blink heuristic masks only the other
test: Compare firmware menu on/off PBM and reconstruct both cursor columns
notes: Before fix blink changes 16 pixels and leaves a line; after fix changes 32 and restores dash

hypothesis: Forth Mini test selects the wrong applet because it assumes 19 menu presses
test: Compare Forth Mini slot and actual menu inventory with hardcoded navigation
notes: Forth slot is 4; three debug taps launch it, while 19 long taps do not

hypothesis: File Fixer direct-launch harness runs beyond applet return and faults in unrelated code
test: Stop execution at validation return PC after launching File Fixer
notes: Stopping at return avoids exception; applet reports bad ptr when AlphaWord table is uninitialized

hypothesis: DrawBitmap source is page-major with bit 1 = black
test: Blit a synthetic 264x64 buffer and compare every LCD pixel
notes: 264 bytes/page; bit r = row, LSB top; 1=black. Full-frame blit matched exactly.

hypothesis: The applet framebuffer at state+25 survives firmware scratch use
test: Run DOOM and compare framebuffer writes with A5/SP bounds
notes: A5=0x68364, state=0x68664, fb=0x6867d, ~0x1549c bytes headroom to SP=0x7fb04.

hypothesis: Wall projection must use perpendicular ray depth to avoid a height jump
test: Compare wall height at distance 135 and 136 before/after the formula change
notes: Old formula jumped 64px to 70px between adjacent cells; perpendicular depth gives a smooth projection.

hypothesis: Shooting checks distance and aim but not line of sight
test: Place an enemy behind a wall and dispatch Space
notes: Added Bresenham line-of-sight; behind-wall shots are rejected.

hypothesis: The DOOM validator's forced tick writes the old timer offset
test: Inspect RayState layout and validator overlay address
notes: Timer is at game+18 after the RayGame_t rewrite; validator now writes base+18.

hypothesis: Minimap base is copied at byte offset x/8 instead of x
test: Inspect the right-side LCD crop after the minimap refactor
notes: Framebuffer is one byte per column; copy 40 columns at x=224.

hypothesis: The new 264x64 raycaster exceeds the 50ms tick budget
test: Measure focus cycles before and after optimization
notes: 8.22M cycles (~249ms) dropped to 3.63M (~110ms) with 2px columns/blocks and a static minimap; tick is 120ms.

hypothesis: Global hit_flash makes every enemy flash when one is hit
test: Read DrawEnemies and ray_game_shoot
notes: Removed global flash from enemy drawing; hit_flash remains for future UI use.

hypothesis: Enemy view is discarded below 96 units of depth
test: Read ray_game_enemy_view and test a close approach
notes: Threshold lowered to 48; centre/bottom math stays inside int16.

hypothesis: RAY_MOVE_STEP is dead because ray_game_move hardcodes >>2
test: Host test expected y-60 after a forward step
notes: ray_game_move now scales COS/SIN by RAY_MOVE_STEP; host test passes.

hypothesis: Aim dot product overflows int16 at long range
test: Review ray_game_shoot arithmetic
notes: Casts lat_abs to int32 before multiplying by 10.

hypothesis: Out-of-bounds wall type reads past the map
test: Call ray_game_wall_type(255,255)
notes: Returns solid wall type 1; covered by host test.

hypothesis: Shaded N/S wall span disappears because the shading path clears mask bits without first filling the span
test: Build the shaded wall variant and inspect the LCD
notes: Fill the span black first, then clear the dither mask; N/S faces now render gray instead of vanishing.
